title: fiig capabilities file (caps.json)
description: Which provider backs each capability (ADR 0027), optionally per package (ADR 0079 §6a). Any string may name an environment variable as ${NAME} (ADR 0071 §6).

packages.description: Package path to capabilities bound only while that package's workflows run (ADR 0079 §6a).

type.description: The provider that backs this capability.

sql.description: A database through Go's database/sql (libraries/sql, ADR 0025).

driver.description: The database/sql driver name; fiig ships sqlite.

dsn.description: The driver's data source name, e.g. file:app.db.

source.description: A stream source written in fiig, bound as StreamSource, that stream adapters read from (ADR 0111), such as fiig.redis. The source reads its own settings from the environment.
The source package's path, e.g. fiig.redis.

lock.description: A schedule lock written in fiig, bound as ScheduleLock, so one replica runs each firing of a schedule adapter's jobs (ADR 0112 §4), such as fiig.redis. The lock reads its own settings from the environment.
The lock package's path, e.g. fiig.redis.

local.description: A ScheduleLock that always claims: this process is the only one running the schedule (ADR 0112 §4).

driver.description: A database driver written in fiig, pooled by the runtime (ADR 0084), such as fiig.postgres (ADR 0085).
The driver package's path, e.g. fiig.postgres.

settings.description: Handed to the driver's connect as strings. fiig.postgres reads host, port, user, password, database, sslmode, and applicationName.

maxConnections.description: The most connections the pool opens (default 10).

idleTimeout.description: How long a connection may sit unused, e.g. 5m (default).

maxLifetime.description: How long any connection is kept, e.g. 30m (default).

socket.description: The real network. Only needed to add certificate authorities or client certificates (ADR 0086), or to change how many idle connections are kept (ADR 0109).

trust.description: PEM files of CA certificates, added to the system's.

systemRoots.description: false trusts only the CAs in trust.

clientCertificates.description: Certificates presented only to the hosts listed for each.

hosts.description: Host names, or *.domain for one label below it.

perKey.description: Idle connections kept per host, port, and package (default 10).

timeout.description: How long a connection may sit idle, e.g. 90s (default).

maxLifetime.description: How old, from when it was opened, a connection may be and still be kept or reused, e.g. 10m (default); 0s for no limit (ADR 0109 §5a).

socketScript.description: A scripted network for tests: each peer's expected writes and canned replies (ADR 0060 §6).

scripted.description: Canned responses per operation, for tests and fiig run (ADR 0027).

randomSeeded.description: A repeatable Random for tests; fiig serve refuses it (ADR 0068 §6).

legacyScripted.description: The older scripted form: operation name to its responses, with no type.
